- Option B: Wed 25 Aug 14:00–15:45 BST / Wed 25 Aug 06:00–07:45 PDT (compressed back-to-back)
- Standby: Thu 26 Aug 08:00–09:30 BST / Thu 26 Aug 00:00–01:30 PDT (backup if vendor availability shifts)

Attachments: draft SOC 2 evidence matrix and a short note on pen-test vendor expectations (attached). I've also added a provisional calendar placeholder here: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=redwood-lumina-provisional

Could you let us know your preferred option and any constraints (e.g., Lumina requires vendor to be present for the pen-test scope call)? Also, please advise if you'd prefer the sessions split across two separate days.

Thanks — happy to adjust.
